Notes: Generated from items.dat: every perk item (AddPerkAction slot >= 10000) OnWear function 53182 args [slot = 10000 + perk PacketID, 4-char action hash, flag, action template id].
ActionId: single-template action. Tiered actions start at Tier 1 LowId (the id function 53182 grants); ActionId appears beside Tiers only when the granted id is not Tier 1 LowId.

Tiers: same-named templates within 30 ids of ActionId that have OnUse functions and are not referenced by another same-named template (cast/proc effects). Pairs are low QL then higher QL in id order; when that leaves templates over, lows and highs are each sorted by effect size and zipped (blocks such as Heal and Light Bullet are stored out of tier order).

Skill scaling: skill = Tier 1 LowId template's Attack skill map (weighted by percentage) x SkillModifier (default 1.0). Each 1000 skill is one tier with QL LowQl-HighQl inside it, as Brawl Item (1-1000 tier 1, 1001-2000 tier 2, ...); skill past the last tier caps at its HighQl.
